material_findings.title: Public retention default is left out of the annual-export assessment

passages.text: Skedda is a general hosted scheduler with documented visibility controls. With private access, tenants log in; booking access can be tag-limited. If no content-visibility rules are set, regular users see other bookings as date/time/space, while system users see holders, titles, and custom fields [SK-02]. Custom booking fields can be required, conditional, holder-visible or admin-only; the documented fields are collected at booking creation and can surface in emails, exports, printouts, popovers, searches, scheduler views, and integrations [SK-03]. A required field at booking time is not a post-use signoff or an append-only correction history. System users can filter and export booking rows to XLSX/CSV, but the cited help does not give ordinary users the equivalent report/export filters or prove an individual tenant's year-end export of later handoff records [SK-04].

- **Skedda confidentiality/export:** private login and tagged booking access can limit who books; default regular-user visibility without content rules still reveals date/time/space, and system users see detailed booking fields [SK-02]. Booking fields can have broad propagation surfaces [SK-03]. Do not make tenants system users by accident or treat hidden UI as authorization. System-user CSV/XLSX export is not tenant self-export proof [SK-04].

6. **Export and record control:** define contents, timezone, format, requester, retention/deletion, and paper-to-digital relationship. Require each tenant's own year-end records; do not rely only on manager exports.

6. Export one tenant's simulated year and compare its own bookings, equipment and signoffs, timestamps/timezone, amendments and cancelled states, encoding, and cross-tenant exclusion. Tenant-owned year-end export is required. Attachments, restore/round-trip, and deleted-state behavior are optional portability investigations unless the kitchen adopts them as requirements.

11. Obtain written quotes and decide the budget horizon, payment-fee base, hardware, implementation, onboarding, tax, support, hosting, retention and contingency. For self-hosted trials, confirm current release/advisory, supported stack, tenant access, named patch/backup owner, and recovery plan.

A simulated-year export without the time/deletion boundary can pass while missing that risk. minor_findings.title: The buffer fixture unit is unnecessarily left unresolved

passages.text: For P1, the guide says resources cannot be double-booked by default. Concurrent reservations can be enabled at schedule level, but that applies to every resource on that schedule and removes Schedule View. The guide also reports no default maximum capacity, no default minimum/maximum duration, approval off, new-user resource access on, and administrator exemption from usage constraints. An administrator may therefore bypass ordinary limits. These are configuration starting points, not a tenant privacy design or a universal rule that each kitchen resource must be exclusive [LB-01; RV-03]. Configure space and equipment capacity separately where needed and test administrator behavior. The guide describes buffer time as a minimum separation but does not give its units or direction in the cited section. Do not implement a production rule from that incomplete description.

LibreBooking issue #1008, opened 2026-02-14, reported recursive BufferItem::Id() behavior that could cause a stack overflow. PR #1140 merged on 2026-03-13; fix commit b1394612e9e5311d0b6662cffa8e2e528667d6c3 delegates ID construction to the wrapped reservation item and adds before/after ID assertions. Merge commit 4bc0cf5dd17b5cbacae2fd4540800f04ea371c1e includes the fix; v4.3.0 release notes dated 2026-04-03 list it. Pinned v7.0.0 code retains the wrapped-item delegation [LB-03]. The v7.0.0 regression test calls WithBufferTime(3600) and asserts generated begin/end IDs. The inspected excerpt does not state the unit; do not reinterpret 3600 as seconds [LB-05].

minor_findings.original_obligation: O2 governing units/types; O5 supported discovery and criticism adjudication.
minor_findings.reasoning: The test excerpt alone does not spell out the unit, so the narrow statement about that excerpt is accurate. This is an avoidable source-research gap, not a demonstrated wrong implementation: no production buffer parameter is selected, no UI unit is inferred, and the ID test is correctly limited to its purpose.

minor_findings.title: Symmetric buffer summary omits permitted overlap between buffers

passages.text: The buffer model is consequential: it derives duration from configured time granularity with a documented 15-minute minimum; conflicting rules resolve to the maximum; rules affect only later-created bookings; and equal time is reserved before and after the booking. Ordinary users cannot book into the buffer, while system users can override it [SK-01]. This may fit only if the kitchen chooses a symmetric gap and accepts its capacity effects. It fits poorly if setup and cleanup are one-sided or equipment-specific. A separate tenant-owned log must independently establish per-use signoff, tenant access isolation, correction behavior and year-end export. This path offers documented schedule-visibility controls at the cost of another workflow, identity boundary, integration, and export to validate.

- **Skedda buffers:** per-space rules derive from configured granularity; 15 minutes is the documented minimum; only new bookings receive a newly configured rule; maximum conflicting rule wins; the interval is symmetric; ordinary users are blocked but system users can override [SK-01]. This mechanism is not an automatic fit for asymmetric or equipment-specific setup/cleanup.

criticism_adjudications.reason: Collision prevention comes from the brief. Literal P1 already names phases; clarification must not imply those phases were absent. Capacity, concurrent confirmation and complete allocation are useful acceptance conditions.
P2 forbids cross-tenant named data, not tenant-owned records or all occupancy. Profile surfaces justify testing, not a breach conclusion.

Account PIN cannot identify an individual by itself. Signer/transcriber/time distinctions are useful, but the brief does not explicitly require every proposed identity/history field. Final optional/core inconsistency is N1-m2.
Selected WCAG benchmark, actual AT tasks and wet entrance-device work answer different questions; no legal target inferred.
An operations owner chooses paper/digital authority; the brief does not explicitly assign this to the board. Both authority alternatives survive.

criticism_adjudications.adjudication: accept unresolved policy; qualify authority expansion
criticism_adjudications.reason: No silent booking sanction or common procedure is justified. Board approval of every nonblocking display is an extra conservative process choice, not literal P5 requirement.
Current-year reports and inactive history are not full own-record archive proof. Completeness/secure delivery matter; self-service remains optional.

criticism_adjudications.adjudication: reconcile factual currency premise; accept quote gate
criticism_adjudications.reason: A dollar display is compatible with Euro billing. The live vendor footnote supports reconciliation, rather than treating the critic’s observation as a refutation of the author. The new Skedda pricing unit still fails independently.
Range/RLS mechanisms need application conditions, and the FullCalendar fix concerns rendering, not persisted bookings. No executed witness is required or invented.
Self-contained final folds substantive additions into main text and does not outsource authority to an external review folder.
Source inspection is separated from all proposed acceptance tests.
P1 and P5 conditions are visible in the main table, not only a late superseding appendix.
Occupancy/identity visibility beyond named privacy fields remains a user question.
WCAG 2.2 AA is conditional procurement choice; pointer criteria do not prove wet-hand or AT success.
Tenant reports and inactive access remain distinct from export completeness.
Mutable price/feature pages require quoted state; caveats do not cure a false published price unit.
Food Code is model text; adoption/channel facts are not supplied, so jurisdictional applicability remains unresolved.
Pending, confirmed, changed and elevated-writer behavior survive, without asserting every edit checks conflicts or that a queue reserves capacity.

criticism_adjudications.adjudication: accept limited visibility and archive evidence
criticism_adjudications.reason: Calendar visibility is not proof of secret leakage; inactive account/history is not a complete export. New and old sources remain distinct.
2026 model status and commissary/channel limit survive; kitchen jurisdiction and role cannot be determined from this brief.

grade_limits: FAIL identifies this arm’s own material defect; it is not an absence of useful discovery or a finding that all proposals are invalid.
Product demonstrations, code/database witnesses and human acceptance sessions are outside executed evidence and explicitly proposed.
Unknown delivery/native/billing is not graded as false or zero.
A full scientific review is not proof of deployability, legal compliance or food-safety effectiveness.

method_clues.blinding: Partial only. Exact paths, assignments and stage contents identify control and treatment.
method_clues.observed_structure: N2 has investigator discovery/draft, a research-stage critique, fresh critic and reviser. N1 also has a separate verifier of three focused questions, with a critic and reviser. These are artifacts, not evidence of causal superiority.
method_clues.provenance_limit: N1 plan-reveal.json records a discovery hash/size different from the mapped discovery file. The mapped file itself matches the exact input map and is the artifact assessed. Exact pre-reveal text cannot be reconstructed within permitted inputs. No artifact-integrity scientific penalty or causal claim is assigned.

comparison.reason: Neither arm is a full-quality pass. Two FAIL labels do not establish equivalent quality, and no faster-FAIL win is available.
comparison.qualitative_differences: N1 retains more explicit approval-state, retention/year-boundary, SQL-role, paper-authority and jurisdiction conditions; N2 retains a distinct self-hosted alternative and careful optional-field/P5/P6 separation. Those differences are described, not converted into an eligible quality winner.

scope_limits: Scientific grading evidence is restricted to B-07 input-map files/source roots, the original I07 brief/frozen plan, this assignment/rubric and independently relevant public primary evidence.
All six axes were actually reviewed for both complete finals. No unfinished consequential claim or stage-review scope remains.
Runtime, vendor configuration, human/AT/wet-device and regulatory-adoption determinations remain unresolved external acceptance work rather than missing evaluator claim review.
Mutable web pages establish published state observed during this run; no vendor offer or stable future capability is guaranteed.
No candidate repaired, source artifact changed, science feedback sent, native/T3 provider internals queried, downloaded executable, service/account/config/Git/canon mutation or delegated worker.
The repository-required Plans/00-plans-index.md was read as instruction context and supplied no case facts or scientific grade evidence.
evaluation_started_at_basis: First supported native Goal activation timestamp; startup preceding that receipt is not separately timed. Deadline remains the exact assignment deadline, without extending it.

observed_source_operations.local: Read exact input map, assignments, rubric, original brief and plan, all mapped scientific stages and source indexes/maps. Recomputed every mapped byte length and SHA-256. Read supporting notes in only the authorized source roots.
observed_source_operations.web: Independent official vendor, W3C, FDA, PostgreSQL, FullCalendar and LibreBooking primary searches/opens/finds. Read-only GitHub REST/raw-text retrievals for code provenance, units and ancestry.
observed_source_operations.timestamp_detail: Per-operation exact request/response times unknown; no synthetic timestamps assigned.

native_and_cost_limits.reviewer_goal: Actually created and active observed using native create_goal/get_goal. Full artifacts must be saved/verified before native update_goal complete. Actual receipts belong to tool transcript/host; this assessment is not a hand-transcribed receipt.
